content:
maria: FYI ran the HF->Redwood converter on a new chat_template and hit a weird token boundary bug.
aj: ugh, details?
derek: tl;dr: assistant role markers in the jinja template got concatenated with adjacent text after conversion. tokenizer broke on the merged token.
maria: repro steps:
- HF template: ```\n{{#system}}You are a helpful assistant.{{/system}}\n{{#user}}Tell me a story about a dog.{{/user}}\n```
- converter output (RW prompt): ```\n<|system|>You are a helpful assistant.<|/system|><|user|>Tell me a story about a dog.<|/user|>\n```
Note the lack of whitespace between closing and opening tags in some cases.
simon: that looks like a whitespace normalization bug in the jinja render pass. Tokenizer then produced a single token for `</system><|user|>` so attention patterns and caching got misaligned.
maria: eval-bot then flagged regressions on a small suite after quantizing the model (q4_0):
eval-bot: ALERT: quality drop 4.2% on instruction-following (prompt-set: chat_template_edgecases). Top failing cases show responses truncated or context ignored.
derek: also found config.json had custom special_tokens mapping in HF model repo which we didn't port to the serving tokenizer config. so even when we fixed spacing, the missing special tokens caused OOV tokens to be split.
aj: quick fix ideas:
- ensure converter inserts explicit separator token between role blocks (e.g., ` <|role_sep|> `) when tags abut
- port HF `tokenizer.json` / `special_tokens_map` into Redwood config during model onboarding
- add a short unit test: render jinja -> run tokenizer -> assert special tokens preserved
simon: agreed. I'll add a small preflight check in the model onboarding pipeline that tokenizes a canonical/edge template and asserts token boundaries.
maria: for immediate mitigation, re-running quantization without aggressive token merging helped. also manually adding "additional_special_tokens": ["<|system|>","<|user|>","<|assistant|>"] to the tokenizer config fixed several failures.
aj: I'll put a PR up for the converter to insert a single space when closing/opening tags collide, and a follow-up to copy HF special token fields into the on-boarded config.
derek: can we also have the eval suite include a small chat-template fuzz set? these edgecases are subtle.
maria: yes — adding that to the onboarding evals ticket. thanks all :thumbsup:
